IS 18722 : Part 1 : 2024 Virgin and Re-Refined Base Oils of Mineral Origin - Specification - Part 1 Group I to Group III Base Oils
ICS 75.100
ICS 75.100
PCD 25
PCD 25
1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes requirements, methods of sampling, and tests for virgin and re-refined base oils of mineral origin. In part 1, Group I to Group III base oils are covered for virgin base oils and Group I is covered for re-refined base oils.
NOTE - The specifications of other base oils are expected to be covered in Part 2.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreement based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
